tickets.title: The synthetic run's KV records outlive KV's minimum expiry (**amendment 13, E37, 2026-10-31**)

authority.locator: E37 · section 2 of amendment 13, "Done when" (P110's reported sites and review follow-ups: _evidence/parity-step3/S58/specifier/REPORT-47d4be8b.md, REPORT-8eeded16.md, S58/reviewer-p110/REPORT-47d4be8b.md, REPORT-8eeded16.md; ruled R-P742 (2)–(4), R-P746 (2); adopted R-P747; in force under the owner's direction, R-P545)
authority.requirement: a synthetic run re-observed at any age within its scope's life reports what it reported at the start: no KV put of the synthetic environment carries an expiration KV refuses.

tickets.outcome: W12.02's later leg (src/index.api-boundary.test.ts :1407) reports learning:false once a synthetic scope is older than about 60 s, because the synthetic environment's KV puts take the scope's expiry (src/ops/synthetic.ts, environment's KV put, :223–224) and KV refuses an expiration less than 60 s ahead; the scope lives 120 s, so it happens on real KV too.

criteria.observable: A started synthetic scope re-observed at every age within its life (a controlled clock: 0 s, 59 s, 61 s, 119 s) reports learning:true where it did at 0 s, on both hosts; no KV put of the synthetic environment carries an expiration less than 60 s ahead; the records still end with the scope (read as absent once the scope has expired). RED at a97195c8 from about 60 s.
criteria.proof: The P112 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P112.SX1 on both hosts, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: W12.02's leg at src/index.api-boundary.test.ts :1407 asserts learning after the recorded deliveries with no dependence on the scope's age; every other expectation unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P112 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P112.SX2 on both hosts, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

existingEvidence.description: KV: 'Invalid expiration … at least 60 seconds in the future'; reproduced with a held delivery.

decisions.effect: The fix is the synthetic environment's KV expiry; the scope's own life and the monitor's design are unchanged.

allowedPaths: src/ops/synthetic.ts (the synthetic environment's KV put expiry only)
src/index.api-boundary.test.ts (R10 by name: W12.02 :1407, its learning asserted after the recorded deliveries; by the specifier; R-P747)

tickets.title: The gate counts, never times: the race-form bounds and the reported sites (**amendment 13, E37, 2026-10-31**)

authority.locator: E37 · section 2 of amendment 13, "Done when" (P110's reported sites and review follow-ups: _evidence/parity-step3/S58/specifier/REPORT-47d4be8b.md, REPORT-8eeded16.md, S58/reviewer-p110/REPORT-47d4be8b.md, REPORT-8eeded16.md; ruled R-P742 (2)–(4), R-P746 (2); adopted R-P747; in force under the owner's direction, R-P545)
authority.requirement: no assertion in the gate's tests bounds wall-clock time from above in any form, races included; the time stays printed as evidence; each counted form turns RED on the defect its timed form caught, shown on a deterministic variant, never by load.

tickets.outcome: P110 converted the clock-read forms and listed the rest; 55 within/Promise.race bounds in 23 files, P96's slack, P64.OT4, W37's settle waits and W12.02's exact successor comparisons remain, and three traded bounds no longer catch a bounded timer wait added on their path.

criteria.observable: Every within/Promise.race/sleep-race bound in a gate test (the 55 in 23 files P110 reported, G16b :531 among them) waits on its event or runs on a controlled clock, or is listed with a true disposition; P110's scan reads the race forms and declarations with type annotations, and fails on an unlisted one.
criteria.proof: The P113 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P113.GT1 on both hosts, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: P96's |sum−total| < SLACK, P64.OT4 and W37's 7 s settle waits assert counts or recorded events, or are proven not to be upper bounds, with the line.
criteria.proof: The P113 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P113.GT2 on both hosts, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: W12.02's exact toEqual(expiredSuccessor) and toEqual(successor) compare a self-re-armed alarm as armed; every other member exact; still RED on a refused send that does work or moves state.
criteria.proof: The P113 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P113.GT3 on both hosts, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: The paths whose wall bound P110 traded (SAME_MS/WHOLE_MS, P94's NOISE_MS under the missing and rejecting faults, W12.02's sibling) are RED when a bounded, non-aborting timer wait is added on them, by counting the timers the path arms, never by time.
criteria.proof: The P113 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P113.GT4 on both hosts, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.
